scout_coverage_summary: Scouts currently collect: name, one_line, sector, problem, solution, target_users, why_now, confidence (0–1), and optionally funding_stage and est_tam. The Scout schema and prompts require primary_thesis (why investable from this lens), key_assumptions (2–4 items), and biggest_unknown (single largest uncertainty). All four Scout types (Market-Driven, Builder/Technical, Pain-Point, Contrarian) explicitly instruct the LLM not to invent founding team details, revenue/ARR, competitors, or valuation; funding_stage and est_tam may be null. The Scout→storage adapter and ScoutInfo model do not persist primary_thesis, key_assumptions, or biggest_unknown, so those hypothesis fields are dropped when discoveries are saved and are not available to the Reviewer. Thus the Reviewer receives only company/sector/problem/solution/target_users/why_now/confidence and optional funding_stage/est_tam—no team, no competitors, no explicit business-model or monetization fields, and no persisted hypothesis fields.
gaps_identified: Founding team and roles: Scout does not collect founder names, roles, experience, or unfair advantage. Reviewer has no input for team_analysis and will consistently output [MISSING] or generic placeholders.

Competitor landscape and market position: Scout explicitly does not collect competitors. Reviewer has no input for competition_analysis and will output [MISSING] or weak inference from sector/solution.

Business model and monetization: Scout collects problem, solution, target_users, and why_now but not pricing, monetization strategy, unit economics, or growth plan. Business_model_analysis will be [MISSING] or inferred only from solution/target_users.

Investment thesis inputs: Scout schema requires primary_thesis, key_assumptions, and biggest_unknown, but ScoutInfo and the Scout→storage adapter do not persist them. Reviewer therefore does not receive these fields and cannot reliably populate investment_thesis from Scout data; investment_thesis will be derived only from the limited company/sector/problem/solution text.

Risk signals and early mitigations: biggest_unknown is required in Scout output but is not persisted in ScoutInfo, so Reviewer does not receive it. Risk_mitigation can only be tied to diligence_red_flags (missing data) and not to Scout’s stated biggest unknown.

Persistence of hypothesis fields: primary_thesis, key_assumptions, and biggest_unknown are produced by Scouts and validated by ScoutOutput but are dropped in scout_output_to_scout_info and are not on ScoutInfo, so they are never stored or passed to Reviewer.
recommendation_notes: Persist Scout hypothesis fields (primary_thesis, key_assumptions, biggest_unknown) end-to-end so Reviewer and Partner can use them for investment_thesis, assumption_feedback, and risk_mitigation. Without this, the upgraded pipeline cannot leverage the hypothesis-oriented Scout design.

Consider extending Scout output (and storage) to include optional founding-team information (e.g. founder names, roles, relevant experience) when the discovery context allows it, so team_analysis can be populated and Partner conviction/human_review logic is not always penalized for missing team.

Consider adding an optional competition/landscape field to Scout output (or a separate optional field for known competitors and market position) so competition_analysis can be at least partially populated when the Scout has that context.

Consider adding optional business-model or monetization bullets to Scout output (e.g. pricing model, unit economics, growth plan) where the Scout’s lens supports it, to improve business_model_analysis and reduce [MISSING] in memos and Partner qualitative checks.

Ensure Scout prompts and schema remain aligned with storage and Reviewer: if hypothesis fields are added to ScoutInfo and the adapter, document that Reviewer expects them so investment_thesis and risk_mitigation can be grounded in Scout reasoning.

Re-evaluate 'do not include team/competitors' in Scout prompts in light of the new VC pipeline: the pipeline now explicitly uses team_analysis and competition_analysis for conviction and human_review; continuing to forbid Scout from providing any team or competitor signal will keep those sections [MISSING] and trigger more Partner fallbacks and human_review_required.
